intent: Lazily reuse one Puppeteer browser process for sequential SVG exports, retain per-render page isolation, and close all browser resources at renderer shutdown.

findings.title: Timeout cleanup was no longer awaited
findings.fix: Retain and await the browser close promise when a render times out.

applied_fixes: Restored awaited browser-process cleanup on render timeout.

learnings.note: No docs/solutions knowledge base was present in this repository.
